<?php
$target = new Fiber(static function () {
    echo 'T|';
    echo Fiber::suspend('Y'), '|';
    return 17;
});
$other = new Fiber(static function () { echo 'X|'; return 99; });
$pair = [$target, 'ReSuMe'];
$maker = static function () {};
$weakMaker = WeakReference::create($maker);
$factoryName = 'fromCallable';
$resume = $maker->$factoryName(callback: $pair);
$copy = clone $resume;
$fcc = $target->resume(...);
$get = Closure::fromCallable([$target, 'getReturn']);
$status = Closure::fromCallable([$target, 'isSuspended']);
$weakTarget = WeakReference::create($target);
echo (int)($resume == $fcc), (int)($resume === $fcc), (int)($copy == $resume), '|';
$pair[0] = $other;
$pair[1] = 'throw';
$factoryName = 'missing';
unset($maker, $pair);
echo (int)($weakMaker->get() === null), '|';
echo $target->start(), '|', (int)$status(), '|';
echo (int)($copy(value: 'R') === null), '|', $get(), '|';
unset($target, $resume, $copy, $fcc, $get, $status);
echo (int)($weakTarget->get() === null);
engine_derived_expectation: The fake Closure freezes receiver and method at factory completion. Later array/name mutation and retirement of the Closure used to call the static factory cannot change its target or invalidate source authority. Clone/FCC equality ignores creation history; bound INPUT is the sole receiver edge.

        echo $row['function'], $row['type'], (int)isset($row['file']), (int)isset($row['line']), '|';

catch (FiberError $error) {
    echo 'I|', $error->getMessage(), '|';
    foreach ($error->getTrace() as $row) {
        echo $row['function'], $row['type'], (int)isset($row['file']), (int)isset($row['line']), '|';

function throwFactoryArgument19() {
    unset($GLOBALS['owner']);
    echo 'A|';
    throw new Exception('factory-argument');
}
$owner = new Fiber(static function () { echo 'B|'; return 17; });
$weak = WeakReference::create($owner);
try { Closure::fromCallable(throwFactoryArgument19()); }
catch (Exception $error) { echo $error->getMessage(), '|'; }
unset($error);
echo (int)($weak->get() === null), '|';
$owner = new Fiber(static function () { echo 'X|'; return 19; });
try { Closure::fromCallable(['Fiber', 'resume']); }
catch (TypeError $error) { echo $error->getMessage(), '|'; }
try { Closure::fromCallable([$owner, 'missing']); }
catch (TypeError $error) { echo $error->getMessage(), '|'; }
try { Closure::fromCallable([$owner, 'resume', 17]); }
catch (TypeError $error) { echo $error->getMessage(), '|'; }
echo (int)$owner->isStarted();

    $error = new Exception('body');

    throw $error;
}

$other = new Fiber(static function () { return 91; });
$target->start();
$name = 'ReSuMe';
$pair = [$target, &$name];
$resume = Closure::fromCallable(callback: $pair);
$name = 'throw';

unset($pair);
try { $resume->__invoke(value: 17); }
catch (Exception $error) {
    echo (int)($error === $GLOBALS['bodyError']), '|', $error->getMessage(), '|';
    foreach ($error->getTrace() as $row) {
        echo $row['function'], isset($row['type']) ? $row['type'] : '.', (int)isset($row['file']), (int)isset($row['line']), '|';
    }
}
echo (int)$target->isTerminated(), (int)$other->isStarted();
